name: CVRPLIB
description: CVRPLIB is the de facto benchmark library for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem and several of its variants. It aggregates the classic instance sets used across the VRP literature, including Augerat (A, B, P), Christofides-Mingozzi-Toth (CMT), Golden, Li, Taillard, and the large Uchoa et al. 'X' set (100 instances, 100-1000 customers). Each instance carries a best-known solution, so routing heuristics and exact methods are scored by how far their total route distance falls from that reference.
domain: combinatorial optimization, operations research, vehicle routing
general_score_metric: total route distance / gap to best-known
typical_sota_score: State-of-the-art branch-cut-and-price solvers prove optimality on most Augerat/CMT instances and many of the smaller X instances; metaheuristics (HGS) match best-known on the large X set.
reputation: The standard reference benchmark for vehicle routing heuristics and exact solvers; the 'established vehicle routing benchmark' against which modern VRP methods report results.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; targets vehicle routing solvers and metaheuristics. Measures solution quality against best-known solutions rather than formulation accuracy. The Uchoa 'X' set (2017) is the current standard for large-scale CVRP evaluation.

institutions: Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro
